title: farmsim: Simulating Physical Verification Capacity for AI-Native Device Software
description: A small discrete-time simulation of a device farm under rising AI-agent change volume. It compares lab-time allocation policies, farm restocking and canary gating using two measures: the verification capacity ratio and fleet-weighted evidence coverage. Includes code, raw results and figures for the article 'Cheap Code, Scarce Hardware: Verifying AI-Native Device Software'.
